run_image_regression_train: run an image regression training job with autotrain using a specified model and dataset
run_image_regression_deploy: deploy a trained image regression model using autotrain with limited availability
run_image_regression_inference: run inference on a trained image regression model using autotrain
register_image_regression_subcommand: register the image-regression subcommand parser with training deployment and inference arguments
create_image_regression_command: create a RunAutoTrainImageRegressionCommand instance from parsed argparse arguments
